returning_30d.query: FROM sales SHOW orders, customers, new_customers, returning_customers, returning_customer_rate SINCE 2026-10-13 UNTIL 2026-11-11

referrer_30d.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_that_completed_checkout GROUP BY referrer_source SINCE 2026-10-13 UNTIL 2026-11-11 ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 10
